Health and Life Sciences

Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

← Back to search
About this programme

A reliable curriculum comparison is currently unavailable. The external curriculum has unresolved requirements; no complete degree pathway is certified here.

VU Gezondheid en Leven studies health from molecules and the human body to behavior, society, healthcare systems and the environment. Fall 2026 entrants combine biomedical and societal study without the former graduation specialisations.

A complete comparison is awaiting verified curriculum information for Fall 2026 entrants. The confirmed subset below contains 60 EC of first-year study and a 30 EC open-study semester. Credits and choice rules for the remaining curriculum are unresolved, so no UCR alternative is presented. This does not establish that a UCR response is impossible.

Academic year: 2026–2027

Verified subset: 90 of 180 EC. The remaining new-cohort course credits, Year-2 choice rules and final research/communication requirements need confirmation. The older specialisation tables do not supply those facts. Lab safety precedes the Biochemistry practical; the Dutch language requirement gates its grade. First-year study/career guidance also gates Toxicology and Epidemiology.
